name: FLIGHT SEC-02: Dynamic Squad Memberships & OAuth Consent Visibility (#1162 & #1161)

squad_membership_write_path.authorization: Target squad lead+ required; requested rank <= granter rank; cannot affect higher rank; self-grant prohibited
squad_membership_write_path.action_capabilities: Bound agents holding action:manage_access can manage memberships; unprivileged agents rejected with operator_principal_required
squad_membership_write_path.audit_receipts: membership_receipts table records all add and remove mutations with prior_capability tracking

oauth_consent_convergence.unminted_visibility: listConsentableAgents includes all active agents (minted and unminted) on accessible squads
oauth_consent_convergence.prospective_preview: Unminted agents display prospective home squad member grant
oauth_consent_convergence.auto_mint_on_consent: POST /oauth/consent auto-mints dedicated member and agent_member_bindings when consenting to unminted agents
oauth_consent_convergence.security_invariants: Floor is admin on target squad; grants clamped to min(agent, human); receipt recorded in oauth_consent_receipts
